entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return this garbage jersey I bought. This is completely unacceptable!
I can certainly look into that for you, and I do apologize for the wait time. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey?
What's the issue? The issue is it's the wrong size! It's way too tight, I can barely get it on. I look ridiculous. I want my money back or an exchange, and I want it now. I'm not playing games.
I understand your frustration with the fit. So, to confirm, the item is undamaged, it's just a preference issue with the size being too tight?
Are you listening to me?! Yes, it's the wrong size! This is the worst service I've ever had. Get me your manager right now. I'm going to leave a review about this everywhere.
I am fully authorized to resolve this for you, sir. I just need to ask a few standard questions. Can you provide me with your order number?
(Muttering) Fine. It's VF88675309. I bought it about two months ago. You'd better not tell me it's too late.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the ClubFit Jersey was delivered 60 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that for our apparel, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely set up an exchange for a different size or process a full refund for you. Which would you prefer?
Oh. Well, that's better. See? Was that so hard? I just want to exchange it for the next size up. That's all I wanted from the start.

Of course. I can process that exchange for you right away. I've just initiated it. You will receive a pre-paid return label in your email within the hour. Just send the original jersey back, and we'll ship out the larger size once we receive it. Is there anything else I can help you with?
